SERVICES

Personalized Skin
and
Beauty Care Treatments

At Tassel Beauty and Wellness Studio, we offer personalized skin care treatments designed to meet your unique needs. Our professional team will assess your skin condition and create a customized treatment plan to help you achieve healthy and glowing skin. Whether you need hydrating facials, acne treatments, or anti-aging solutions, we have the expertise to provide effective and safe services.

MAKE A BOOKING

Relaxing and Sculpting Massage Therapy Sessions

Indulge in our relaxing message therapy sessions at Tassel Beauty and Wellness Studio.

From Swedish messages to deep tissue techniques, our skilled therapists will help you unwind and de-stress after a long day. Experience the healing benefits of a massage as it improves circulation, relieves tension, and promotes overall wellness.

We also offer targeted body treatments such as body scrubs and wraps, as well as wood massage, also known as Madero-Therapy treatment using wooden tools to break down fat, sculpt, redefine, reduce cellulite, promote weight loss, and provide different massage treatments for various body areas. These instruments allow highly targeted pressure to be applied to problem areas, such as thighs, buttocks, love handles and abdomen.

Expert Waxing Services

Get ready to flaunt silky smooth skin with our expert waxing services at Tassel Beauty and Wellness Studio. Our trained professionals use high-quality wax products to ensure a comfortable experience with long-lasting results. Say goodbye to razors and enjoy flawless hair removal for all areas of the body.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

What skin and beauty care treatments do you offer?

We offer a wide range of skin and beauty care treatments including facials, massages, manicures, pedicures, waxing services, and more.We offer a wide range of skin and beauty care treatments including facials, massages, manicures, pedicures, waxing services, and more.

Are your services safe and professional?

Yes, our services are provided by trained professionals who prioritize safety and adhere to industry standards to ensure a comfortable experience for all clients.

How do you personalize services for individual needs?

We customize each treatment based on the specific requirements and preferences of our clients to deliver personalized experiences that meet their unique beauty and wellness goals.

Do you use organic or natural products in your treatments?

Our studio values using high-quality products. We carefully select premium skincare products that are gentle on the skin, often opting for organic or natural options for a luxurious experience.

Can men also benefit from your beauty care treatments?

Absolutely! Our studio welcomes clients of all genders. Men can enjoy our range of grooming services such as facials, massages tailored for them along with other popular offerings
